Triple Berry Coconut Smoothie
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Friday, May 27, 2016 - 6:15am

Ingredients




1 cup almond milk
3/4 cup blueberry Greek yogurt
10 oz. fresh strawberries (washed and hulled)
3 oz. fresh blueberries (washed)
5 oz. fresh blackberries (washed)
1/2 cup organic dried coconut slices
1 cup ice

Preparation

1 Use a blender 2 Add the almond milk, yogurt, fresh berries, coconut slices and ice 3 Blend until smooth (or use your blender smoothie setting if you have one) 4 Pour into a glass 5 Enjoy!

About

Triple Berry Coconut Smoothie is pretty and tasty.  Flavoured with 3 types of fresh berries, raw coconut slices and yogurt, this healthy smoothie is perfect for breakfast or lunch.
